audit.why: 46.15% over 26 games with a chart of Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Skill / Ornn / Ornn — a losing lane that Galio survives rather than wins, which matches. The verdict was sound; the sequencing under it was missing entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it is accurate — not one number appears in either layer, while whys[4] also calls Hero's Entrance 'a global rotation'.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at 800, Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 at 450, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100 at 2500. Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 onto an ALLY within 4000/4750/5500.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into early, mid, spikes[0], breakdown.cooldowns, loading and dosFull[0].d; the global claim corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Ornn 'E-charges into it to knock you up' but never states the condition, so it reads as an unconditional knockup.
audit.why: Riot: 'If Ornn collides with TERRAIN while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.' No terrain collision means Searing Charge is a 450-range dash with no crowd control at all — and the pillar Volcanic Rupture leaves is the terrain he manufactures for it.
audit.corrected: Deny the pillar and there is no knockup. Written into early, report[5], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wave management is generic and never mentions the one thing that makes Ornn's wave game different from every other top laner.
audit.why: Riot on Living Forge: 'Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items ANYWHERE.' He never has to recall to shop, so crashing a wave on him costs him nothing in tempo and the usual cheater-recall logic does not apply.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] blames the first-item swing on 'Brittle amplification' and 'the magic-reduction shield does nothing'.
audit.why: There is a verifiable reason that does not depend on Brittle at all: Living Forge grants Ornn 'an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from ALL SOURCES', so every defensive item he buys is worth more than it says on the tooltip, and an AP Galio is stat-checked twice over.
audit.corrected: whys[5] rewritten around Living Forge's resistance bonus.

edits.after: With Q-W-E up, your only clean punish is E into W-taunt if Ornn whiffs his Q pillar — Volcanic Rupture is 9s and Searing Charge 14s, so a whiffed pillar is a real window. Don't over-commit.

edits.before: You don't win the straight 1v1, so stop trying to. Your edge is Hero's Entrance at 6 — even in a losing lane, flag a winning lane and drop in for a kill, because Ornn is immobile and can't punish you for leaving. If you do fight, bait his Q pillar and W (Bellows Breath) first; his Brittle is on a meaningful cooldown, and only then is your E into W-taunt safe. Eat his E-charge engage with the shield, taunt him onto the wave, and reset — you're farming for items and roam value, not a lane kill. Don't stand in lane trading autos; his Brittle amplifies the next CC and adds true damage your shield can't reduce.
edits.after: You don't win the straight 1v1, so stop trying to. Your edge is Hero's Entrance at 6 — even in a losing lane, land on an ally up to 4000 units away and take a kill, because Ornn is immobile and can't punish you for leaving. If you do fight, bait Volcanic Rupture (9s) and Bellows Breath (12s) first; only then is your E into W-taunt safe, and Searing Charge is 14 seconds, so a spent charge is a long window with no knockup behind it. Eat his engage with the shield, taunt him onto the wave, and reset — you're farming for items and roam value, not a lane kill you cannot get.

edits.before: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) drops a magma pillar and slows; his real threat is E (Searing Charge) dashing into that pillar or any terrain to knock you up, then W (Bellows Breath) breathing fire to apply Brittle. Shield of Durand does almost nothing here because his damage is physical and the Brittle proc is true — the W's heavy magic-reduction is wasted into a pure-AD/true tank. Last-hit with the tip of your Q tornado so you chip him without walking into Q-pillar-plus-E range, and never E in carelessly: he'll Q a pillar behind you and E-knock you into his Brittle setup. At Level 3 your E (Justice Punch) into W-taunt is your one clean punish if he whiffs the pillar to poke a creep — but don't force it, you don't out-stat him in extended trades.
edits.after: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) drops a magma pillar and slows on a 9-second cooldown; his real threat is E (Searing Charge, 14s) dashing into that pillar or any other wall, because Riot only gives the knockup when he COLLIDES with terrain — no pillar, no knockup, just a 450-range dash. Then W (Bellows Breath, 12s) breathes fire to apply Brittle. Living Forge also hands him bonus armour and magic resist from every source, so an AP stat-check is the worst plan you own. Last-hit with the tip of your Q tornado so you chip him from outside pillar-plus-charge range, and never E in carelessly: he will drop a pillar behind you and charge into it. At Level 3 your E (Justice Punch) into W-taunt is your one clean punish on a whiffed pillar.

edits.before: Self-itemize tanky via Living Forge and upgrade allied items at 13 to out-scale you into an unkillable frontline
edits.after: Buy items in lane through Living Forge and upgrade allied gear at 13, out-scaling him into an unkillable frontline

edits.after: Best wave: held near your side so Ornn overextends into punch range. Worst wave: shoved to his tower with W and E down. Living Forge lets him buy without recalling, so a crash never costs him a shop trip — crash for plates or a map look instead.

notes: The packet's 'no cooldown sequencing anywhere' flag was exactly right — the entry named every ability correctly and gave not one number, so 'bait his Q and W first' had nothing to count. Added Volcanic Rupture 9s, Bellows Breath 12s, Searing Charge 14s and Call of the Forge God 140s, plus the condition that actually gates his engage: Searing Charge knocks up ONLY on a terrain collision, which is why the Q pillar exists. Also added Living Forge properly — it gives bonus armour and magic resist from ALL sources (a verifiable reason an AP Galio loses the stat-check) and lets him shop without recalling, which changes the wave game and appeared nowhere. UNVERIFIED, LEFT IN PLACE: four strings state that Ornn's Brittle proc deals TRUE damage (spikes[2], spikes[3], whys[3], whys[6]) and build the itemization advice on it. Riot's kit text says only that enemies 'become Brittle' with no damage type given, so I could neither confirm nor refute it and did not restate it in anything I rewrote — see questionsForUser.
